chunks: O you who believe, bow in adoration, Worship your Lord and do what is good that you may find success.
ai.seo_question: What are the key commands given to believers in Surah Al-Hajj regarding worship and goodness?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to emphasize the unity of ritual prayer (Salat) and moral conduct (Ihsan), where bowing and prostration are not merely physical postures but expressions of humility before God. The command to 'do good' is interpreted broadly to include all righteous deeds, reinforcing the Shia principle that faith must be manifested through both inward devotion and outward social justice. This holistic view of worship underscores that true success (Falah) is achieved only when spiritual discipline aligns with ethical action.
